name: Rowbly Updater
description:
We want to tell users when their is a new version of rowbly available.

- When starting up rowbly, run an async check to see if there is a new version available
- Check npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/rowbly
- If a new version is available, inform the user that they can update by running `npm i -g rowbly`

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor: ROW68 plan ACCEPTED with refinements. Confirm aborting on exit also clears all timeout/request handles so no rejection or delayed exit; handle stale/unmounted promise resolution safely. ROWBLY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 and demo skip accepted. No need cache/preferences machinery. Preserve readable update text and npm i -g rowbly at normal80-column width; do not accept an unreadable notice merely as a known risk. Use width-aware existing footer conventions, shorten/replace current-version area or a small existing-layout message as needed while retaining usable key hints; show80 and narrow screenshots. Avoid unsolicited new TUI context abstraction if simple existing wiring suffices. ADR0047 is RESERVED for ROW53 guide exception if user approves and0048 reservedROW50heartbeat; use0049 provisionally for ROW68 firstnetworkcall decision, recheck allmain/openPR reservations. Keep ADR concise/current behavior, no reversal of existing decisions. Manual controlled network success/failure/hang/abort scenarios plus exactTUI startup/quit and optout, commandJSON unchanged; fourchecks required. Extend a kept test only if AGENTS required contract/race rules genuinely apply, no mirror tests. comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Supervisor review: do not ship a known added five-second quit delay from the update check as an accepted residual. Prompt exit was part of the accepted plan and this optional notice must not hold the TUI process open. Keep transport changes request-local; do not change or destroy global agents or bypass the configured proxy. Prefer a request-local cancellable agent/transport if small and supported. If native environment-proxy CONNECT cannot safely be cancelled with the supported runtime, skip this optional check when that proxy routing is active and document that limitation; silent unavailable is preferable to adding a quit delay. This is permitted within the existing silent-failure/opt-out scope, not a request for a new proxy implementation. Verify direct success, offline/unreachable, hanging proxy and immediate quit with no update-owned handles left; preserve commands with no request/output. Update ADR0049/docs to match actual behavior, no broad infrastructure. Proceed with this refinement before final handoff; report any remaining design conflict instead of silently accepting delayed exit.

comments.author: sunny
comments.body: Draft PR: https://github.com/sgolovine/rowbly/pull/144 (branch factory/row-68, commit 64f601f). When the TUI starts, Rowbly reads npm's latest manifest in the background; if a newer release exists, a row above the footer says 'Rowbly <version> is available, update with npm i -g rowbly' (short form on narrow terminals), with key hints kept at full width. The check never delays startup or quitting: 3 s timeout, unreferenced socket and timer, a request-local DNS resolver that quitting cancels, and it is skipped when Node routes HTTPS through an environment proxy (whose CONNECT Node cannot cancel). Failures show nothing; ROWBLY_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1 turns it off; commands, --json and --no-prompt make no request. ADR-0049, user guide and skill references updated. typecheck, lint, test:unit (78) and test:cli (20) pass; screenshots at 40/60/80/120 columns are in the PR comment.
